title: Different type, same spot: state resets

slides.text: Swap the type, lose the state 🔄
slides.say: Render a different component at the same position, and React throws away the old state.
Switch from Counter to a p tag, and back. The counter is destroyed with its state, then created fresh.
It even happens one level up. If the parent changes from div to section, the whole subtree below is destroyed, including Counter.

slides.text: Keep state across renders? Make the tree structure match.
slides.say: Rule of thumb: to keep state between re-renders, the structure of your tree must match from one render to the next.
